newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Ericsson still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Ericsson still a buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers and local associate Banco Patrimonio said they are maintaining their buy recommendation on Brazilian telecoms equipment maker Ericsson Telecomunicacoes SA.
-- Analyst Ricardo Gurman said in a report that earnings momentum at Ericsson, the local unit of Swedan's Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson, should continue.

-- "We believe that the Brazilian telecom industry enjoys a compelling outlook due to strong pent-up demand for telecoms services in the country and the deregulation and privatization process underway," he wrote.

-- Ericsson has strong competitive advantages, including its large installed base, reputation as a high-quality supplier and long history in Brazil as well as Ericsson Group's position as a world leader in telecommunications technology, he said.
-- Despite their strong rise since early 1996, Ericsson shares "remain an attractive vehicle to play the high-growth telecom equipment industry," Gurman wrote.
-- Ericsson preferred fell 0.86 percent to close Friday at 57.50 reais, while its common ended the week up 1.01 percent at 49 reais in Sao Paulo.
